description: Kotlin class A2UIHandler that manages interactions with a UI component via a canvas, URL resolution, message decoding, and script application.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing A2 UI interactions, including URL resolution, message decoding, and communication with a canvas controller.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted canvas action URL based on predefined trust rules.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the A2 UI host URL based on provided node or operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Ensures that the A2 UI is ready by evaluating a JavaScript snippet repeatedly until the UI signals readiness.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes and validates messages received from the A2 UI, supporting JSONL and message array formats.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates the structure of a JSON message, ensuring compliance with expected message types and versions.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code string to apply messages to the A2 UI.
